purpose: Configuration contract for the federated project-boundary and evidence writer.

crossRecordRules: project.id MUST be unique within the envelope
repository.id MUST be unique within the envelope
evidence.id MUST be unique within the envelope
relation.id MUST be unique within the envelope
relation.sourceId and relation.targetId MUST resolve to an envelope node or an existing database node
relation.projectId MUST equal the source projectId or target projectId unless evidenceState is proposed
authority.sha MUST be a verified commit SHA; placeholders are quarantined
records with rightsStatus=rejected MUST NOT be written
records with credential findings MUST be quarantined

cypherTemplates.run: MERGE (r:Run {idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey}) ON CREATE SET r.id=$runId, r.startedAt=$startedAt, r.mode=$mode, r.status='started', r.sourceRef=$sourceRef, r.configVersion=$configVersion, r.operator=$operator ON MATCH SET r.lastSeenAt=$observedAt RETURN r.id AS id, r.idempotencyKey AS idempotencyKey
cypherTemplates.runFinalize: MATCH (r:Run {idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey}) SET r.status=$status, r.finishedAt=$finishedAt, r.acceptedCount=$acceptedCount, r.rejectedCount=$rejectedCount, r.schemaInvalidCount=$schemaInvalidCount, r.credentialCount=$credentialCount, r.unsafeArchiveCount=$unsafeArchiveCount, r.neo4jMutationCount=$neo4jMutationCount, r.summary=$summary RETURN r.id AS id, r.status AS status
cypherTemplates.project: MERGE (p:Project {id: $id}) ON CREATE SET p.createdAt=$observedAt SET p.name=$name, p.description=$description, p.purpose=$purpose, p.owner=$owner, p.status=$status, p.visibility=$visibility, p.rightsStatus=$rightsStatus, p.projectId=$projectId, p.platformRole=$platformRole, p.sourceRef=$sourceRef, p.ingestionRunId=$runId RETURN p.id AS id
cypherTemplates.repository: MERGE (r:Repository {id: $id}) ON CREATE SET r.createdAt=$observedAt SET r.name=$name, r.projectId=$projectId, r.repository=$repository, r.ref=$ref, r.sha=$sha, r.sourceClass=$sourceClass, r.fileCount=$fileCount, r.observedFiles=$observedFiles, r.sourceRef=$sourceRef, r.ingestionRunId=$runId RETURN r.id AS id
cypherTemplates.evidence: MERGE (e:Evidence {id: $id}) ON CREATE SET e.createdAt=$observedAt SET e.name=$name, e.projectId=$projectId, e.status=$status, e.evidenceClass=$evidenceClass, e.contentHash=$contentHash, e.sourceFiles=$sourceFiles, e.observedAt=$observedAt, e.actor=$actor, e.summary=$summary, e.rightsStatus=$rightsStatus, e.sourceRef=$sourceRef, e.ingestionRunId=$runId RETURN e.id AS id
cypherTemplates.relation: MATCH (s {id: $sourceId}), (t {id: $targetId}) MERGE (s)-[rel:RELATED {relationKey: $relationKey}]->(t) ON CREATE SET rel.type=$type, rel.projectId=$projectId, rel.evidenceState=$evidenceState, rel.confidence=$confidence, rel.observedAt=$observedAt, rel.ingestionRunId=$runId RETURN rel.relationKey AS relationKey

mcp.notes: Enable the Neo4j MCP server for the writer service, but keep Aura Agent imports read-only until the data model and promotion gates are proven.
